control_profile: Controls off: unchanged +0.25 price-confirmed carry targets with no volatility scaling, drawdown brake, position stop, time stop or turnover throttle.
falsifier: Removing all controls does not reduce turnover and improve edge/folds, or instead worsens drawdown, roles, costs and regime breadth.
formation_horizon: robust seven-day and twenty-eight-day settled funding with a twenty-eight-day BTC state, twenty-one-bar residual scale and nine-bar price confirmation at z 0.25
hypothesis: An uncontrolled replay isolates raw confirmed-carry behavior and tests whether organizer controls create the observed churn, weak chop and fold failures.
rebalance_horizon: one daily cohort averaged across seven overlapping daily vintages
